notes:
v0.1.4 — Hyper-V auto-TCG + VM snapshots:
- Auto-detect: when full Hyper-V role is enabled (root partition), controller skips WHPX (would crash in 7s) and uses TCG immediately
- New CLI: winmux snapshot {save,restore,delete,list} — save/restore guest VM state (great before claude --auto runs)
- New command palette entries in Desktop: Save snapshot, Restore snapshot, List snapshots, Delete snapshot
- SSH key visible inside guest at /workspace/winmux-keys/* if you copied it from the new install helper
